name: agy-pi-bridge
description: Migrates Pi's battle-tested subagent roles (oracle, librarian, worker, frontend-scout, frontend-worker) with Antigravity-native async parallel dispatch rules, and dynamically bridges locally installed Pi tools (fast_context_search, search, docs_search, web_fetch, devin_search) via MCP.
author: justhil
suggestedPrompts: Launch parallel worker subagents in isolated branch workspaces for independent modules
Ask oracle in a fresh context to blind-review the current git diff
Use fast_context_search to locate where authentication or routing is implemented
